t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Kahnarayshin sungskaka, Agaeutma. Doyooha biliyakelrhuvoongs, nahllooskifkanuk, chale ookfakishkatootin. Waneheuha nahllunrehkaw chayweluljekah etpet dowghan gahluteevnunllu. Etpet dowghan ataklowghen dut dummyetah bektlooghe. Awtiamikloo owahten Agaeutchetdownunuen, cheyun-ahlboodoo nawllooghahrngownakoo awh-rmahgeepuna. Keevitloo ahnehrtooreshtengoölootin.
